facts.fact: La Nation reports that the DGPF searches the national population database for each ID applicant and integrates each file into the Registre national des personnes physiques platform, with data recorded there before biometric enrolment.

facts.fact: The Djibouti digital ministry's page says Law 39/AN/19 of 21 January 2019 provides for a centralised biometric national register of natural persons (RNPP) and a national identification number (NNI) assigned at birth.
